task.title: Restore an archived profile
task.shortdesc: Return an archived profile to the active Library lifecycle when it should be edited or used again.

prereq.p: The lifecycle filter shows archived or all profiles, and the target profile row is visible.

context.p: Restore reverses archive. It does not revalidate the profile or change policy values.

step.cmd: Confirm the archived row identity and updated time.

info.p: Expected result: you identify the archived profile you want to bring back.

info.note: Restore makes the profile active again, but its previous validation state may still need review.

step.cmd: Switch to the active lifecycle filter or all profiles to confirm the restored row.

info.p: Refresh if the status reports success but the row remains hidden.

result.p: The profile is active again and available for normal editor workflows.

postreq.p: Recovery: archive the profile again if it was restored by mistake.
